note: Both sets correctly extract the core statistic that residential lighting accounts for 22% of household electrical use in California (Set A Claim 2, Set B Claim 1). However, both sets also include a claim that misbinds this percentage to 'households electrical use' instead of 'residential lighting' (Set A Claim 1, Set B Claim 2). Set B is inferior because it adds a third redundant claim with a semantically imprecise attribute ('average household electrical use' for a percentage value), violating the preference for fewer vague or trivial claims.
